propositions: Code review lacks a dedicated concurrency criterion for detecting race conditions despite existing security and performance overlays

The proposed concurrency overlay uses a lockset-first lexical trigger with two tiers: a committed high-precision tier (stack-agnostic, low-noise, fires on explicit synchronization primitives) and a project-extensible noisy tier configured in criteria_routing.json

The committed tier deliberately does not fire on modal unlocked-twin races (raw git operations, file stat-then-remove patterns) but the project tier catches them via repo-specific vocabulary extension

The overlay must be registered as advisory (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) and deliver a Pass-1 reviewer prompt, unit tests covering sync-primitive and unlocked-twin corpus cases, and documented two-layer trigger design
